home.heroSub: Claude plans, codes, and deploys — you just approve.
home.step1Sub: Describe what your app does — Claude asks questions for deeper understanding.
home.step2Sub: 12 specialized AI agents work on planning, architecture, code and tests — in real time.
home.step3Sub: Get a link to your app deployed automatically on GitHub and Render.
home.featTitle: What Power Plan builds for you
home.feat1Sub: 12 specialized AI agents — from product discovery to DevOps.
home.feat2Sub: Live feed with all technical decisions and virtual team meetings.
home.feat3Sub: GitHub repo + MongoDB Atlas + Render deployment — all automatic.
home.trustTagline: Real production code — not a prototype
home.ctaPain: A Full-Stack developer costs $150+ per hour.
home.ctaSub: No technical knowledge. No credit card.
home.faq1Q: What stack do the built apps use?
home.faq1A: Every app is built with React + Node.js + MongoDB — a proven production stack.
home.faq2A: Yes. Includes full auth, API, DB schemas, tests, CI/CD and automatic deployment.
home.faq3Q: How much does Power Plan cost?
home.faq3A: Power Plan itself is free. You only pay for Anthropic API usage — typically $2–5 per full project.
home.checklistSub: The bugs most projects don't know exist — built-in automatically.
home.check1Sub: Prevents iOS Safari auto-zoom when tapping an input field
home.check2Sub: Accounts for the dynamic address bar on mobile browsers
home.check3Sub: flex: 1 + min-height: 0 — fills height without a broken max-height
home.check4Sub: Scroll on window, not on a parent with overflow: hidden
home.check5Sub: Every button and tab meets Apple HIG requirements
home.check6Sub: Footer & header use env(safe-area-inset-*) — no cutoff
home.check7Sub: Global user-select: none — no dictionary popup on long-press
home.check9Sub: dir=auto on mixed Hebrew-English text — no word splitting
home.check10Sub: Theme & direction load before React — no visual flash on reload

github.title: GitHub Access Code Required
github.reason: Before we start writing code, we need somewhere to save it. Code will be saved in your GitHub.
github.howtoTitle: How to get an access code?
github.step1: Go to github.com (create a free account if you don't have one)
github.step2: Your avatar → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic)
github.step3: Click "Generate new token" → select scope: repo only → copy

render.title: Render Access Code Required
render.reason: To deploy your app to the internet, we need access to your Render account.
render.cost: 💡 Render offers a free tier — your app will run for free.
render.howtoTitle: How to get an access code?
render.step1: Go to render.com (create a free account if you don't have one)
render.step2: Account Settings → API Keys → Create API Key
